description: C-46A-45-CU c/n 30391 (ex USAAF 42-96729, CX-BCN), force-landed near Santiago del Estero 1964, registered LQ-IYV to the provincial aviation service 1968 and named 'Huaira Sorckoj'; abandoned, then preserved on the north access of Loreto (moved 2008), repainted blue by 2023, one wing detached by vandals 12 November 2025.
museum_name: Curtiss C-46 Huaira Sorckoj Plaza, Loreto
